fail_closed_rule.diagnostic_rule: retain all raw probabilities and all sub-1pp crossings as explicitly flagged observation-only evidence
fail_closed_rule.meaning: does not alter any frozen probability; preserves coherent predictions while failing closed on materially incoherent ladders
fail_closed_rule.raw_probability_rule: exclude the entire player-game from candidate/upload/execution eligibility when max(p1.5-p0.5,p2.5-p1.5) >= 0.01
